rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for replacing stale air in a room or building.

example.english: The room is stuffy, so we need to ventilate it by opening the windows.
example.jyutping: gaan1 fong4 hou2 guk6 jiu3 hoi1 coeng1 tung1 fung1

rows.note: Use this for putting an issue before the public for discussion or examination.

example.english: We should ventilate this issue in public so everyone can examine it together.
example.traditional: 呢個議題應該攞出嚟公開討論，等大家一齊研究。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 ji5 tai4 jing1 goi1 lo2 ceot1 lai4 gung1 hoi1 tou2 leon6 dang2 daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 jin4 gau3

rows.note: Use this medical construction when supporting a patient's breathing, whether manually or with equipment.

example.english: The first-aider had to ventilate the injured person until the ambulance arrived.
example.traditional: 急救員要幫傷者呼吸，等佢捱到救護車到。
example.jyutping: gap1 gau3 jyun4 jiu3 bong1 soeng1 ze2 fu1 kap1 dang2 keoi5 ngaai4 dou3 gau3 wu6 ce1 dou3
